mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (name, description, owner_id, invite_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{ownerId}, #{inviteCode}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, joined_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.sql: id, name, description, owner_id, invite_code, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM teams WHERE id = #{teamId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM teams WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT role FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT m.user_id, u.nickname, u.level, m.role, m.joined_at FROM team_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY (m.role = 'OWNER') DESC, m.joined_at ASC, m.user_id ASC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.description, m.role AS my_role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members c WHERE c.team_id = t.id) AS member_count, o.nickname AS owner_nickname, m.joined_at FROM team_members m JOIN teams t ON t.id = m.team_id JOIN users o ON o.id = t.owner_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.joined_at DESC, t.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE teams SET name = #{name}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{teamId}
UPDATE teams SET invite_code = #{inviteCode} WHERE id = #{teamId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM team_members WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId}
